note: sqlite3_txn_state: idle 0; a deferred BEGIN alone stays 0; a SELECT lifts to read 1; a write lifts to write 2; COMMIT returns to 0
BEGIN IMMEDIATE and BEGIN EXCLUSIVE start a write txn (2) immediately; ROLLBACK/COMMIT return to 0
table cursor: literal INSERTs persist; reopen SELECTs all rows by rowid and seeks a single rowid
cursor DELETE removes a rowid cell and literal UPDATE replaces a cell; reopen reflects both; deleted rowid seek is empty; integrity_check ok
